name: Blanket attendant
design: Heavy-set tall adult male Yautja, rich umber spotted hide, domed bony crown, four broad mandibles, dense long black tendrils tied loosely behind shoulders. Muted cream coarse tunic with dark brown short shoulder shawl, blue-grey wide waist sash, dark calf trousers with clawed bare feet. Carries a folded thick striped saddle blanket over both forearms across waist; blanket geometric stripes only and stays close to body.
